query_all_devices: query all connected IoT devices via TCP socket on port 8889 and render device list
query_device_apps: query installed apps on a specific IoT device by IP and port via TCP socket
install_wasm_app: install a WASM applet on an IoT device by sending an install command over TCP
uninstall_wasm_app: uninstall a WASM applet from an IoT device by sending an uninstall command over TCP
upload_wasm_app: upload a new WASM app file to the static upload directory and add it to the app store
